entities.summary: Sudi Silalahi (b. 1949-07-13, Pematangsiantar) was a public servant or civil administrator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Pematangsiantar and Indonesia. Known in the fields of indonesia, military leaders & commanders, asia.
